acceptances.reason: the sheet publishes both: a glass transition of 145 °C by DSC and a Vicat of 119 °C at 50 N. A Vicat below the glass transition is what a needle under load gives on a bar that has not been annealed, and both are the maker’s own numbers.
the strain the sheet publishes is below what its own stress and modulus imply, which is systematic across makers where the modulus is a secant taken at a smaller strain than failure.
the same on the same maker’s polycarbonate sheet.
